36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
124142: Senkuu is a genius with a vast amount of scientific knowledge. He is able to invent various kinds of tools and gadgets in a short amount of time with ease. As a child, he designed and built a functioning miniature rocket ship.
124143: Kohaku is a young woman who is a descendant of modern humans. She is Ruri's younger sister and the daughter of Kokuyo. She appears to be well known in her village due to her combative abilities, as both Kinro and Ginro were afraid of her.
124144: According to Taiju, Tsukasa has the reputation as "The Strongest High School Primate" due to his tremendous fighting abilities. Tsukasa is essentially violent, but extremely careful and aware of his actions.
124145: Chrome is the alleged sorcerer - eventually turned scientist - of Ishigami Village. As part of the Kingdom of Science, Chrome serves as the unofficial right hand of Senku; this trust is what makes him one of the Five Wise Generals.
124146: Taiju is an outgoing, friendly, and kind person. He's enthusiastic about performing even small tasks and a diligent worker. He is very determined when something is important to him. He tends to yell loudly and is enthusiastic regardless of the task so long as he proves useful.
124147: Yuzuriha is the love interest of Taiju and a friend of Senkuu. Yuzuriha is a young woman with brown hair, brown eyes, and a slim build. She has two noticeable petrification scars, both in the shape of spirals, located on her shoulder and neck.
124162: Suika is a young girl who lives in the village with the other stone age humans. Her most notable feature is the large watermelon on her head, which she can climb inside to disguise herself as the fruit.
127445: Gen Asagiri is an enemy turned ally of Senku. Originally de-petrified by Tsukasa Shishio, he was sent to find Senku, only to defect to the Kingdom of Science. Gen later becomes one of the Five Wise Generals.
136446: Kaseki is an elderly craftsman from the Ishigami Village. When Senku arrives at Ishigami village, Kaseki is introduced as an artisan, and through Senku, his dedication to his craft is reignited tenfold.
143270: Ginrou is Kinrou's younger brother and one of the village guards. He is shorter and scrawnier than his brother, with short blonde hair and green eyes. He usually wears a karate gi-like uniform and belt and carries his spear wherever he goes.
143271: Kinrou is the elder brother of Ginrou and the son of Tetsuken and Shirogane. Originally having served as one of the guards of Ishigami Village alongside Ginrou, he quickly joined Senku as a member of the Kingdom of Science.
143272: Ruri is Kohaku's elder sister and the daughter of Kokuyo, and serves as the priestess of Ishigami Village. She is similar to Kohaku in appearance but has longer hair and a more hourglass-shaped body. She wears a black sundress and a piece of rope around her neck.
145061: You is a pre-petrification human and former policeman who is revived by Tsukasa. He faked his death after Chrome's escape to avoid the blame, then eventually joins the Kingdom of Science after the stone wars are over.
145062: Hyoga is a survivor who was revived by Tsukasa Shishio. Initially, he was an elite member of the Tsukasa Empire since he was depetrified by Tsukasa. Hyoga has an easy going attitude towards everything. Even in situation that do not work in his favour, he still remains calm.
145063: Nikki is a survivor that was revived by Tsukasa, who assigned her to keep watch over Taiju and Yuzuriha. She later defected from the Tsukasa Empire and joined the Kingdom of Science, where her unofficial role is that of disciplinarian.
145064: Ukyou is a survivor that was revived by Tsukasa Shishiou. He is pacifistic and dislikes needless bloodshed.
145065: Homura acts as the right-hand man of Hyouga in Tsukasa's army. She was a competitive gymnast before the petrification.
145095: Magma is a villager from the Ishigami village. Magma is known for being the strongest of all the Villagers in terms of strength.
145096: Minami is a Pre-Petrification human and former reporter before the Petrification occurred.
145097: Ryuusui Nanami is the son of the owner of Nanami Conglomorate. He was revived by Senku for his expertise in sailing. His wisdom about adventuring at sea or air makes him indispensable as one of the Five Wise Generals of the Kingdom of Science.
145098: Francois is Ryuusui's faithful and extremely talented butler whose services were well sought out and coveted before the Petrification. Their gender remains unknown. They are demonstrated to be a supreme chef.
145099: Soyuz is a member of Ishigami Village.
145100: Initial Age (mental): 6 Initial Age (physical): 12 Mirai is the beloved little sister of Tsukasa. Mirai was clinically brain dead prior to the Petrification, the doctors saying she'd never wake up.
147567: Dog from Ishigami Village. He is Suika's friend.
147570: Mantle is a villager of Ishigami Village who idolizes Magma.
147640: An inhabitant of Ishigami Village who is a stickler for the rules. He serves alongside Turquoise as guard for the village's priestess.
149274: A famous American diva and songstress whose name is known by the whole world. Her passion in adventuring lead her aboard the International Space Station (ISS) alongside Senku's father, Byuakuya Ishigami.
149275: Byakuya Ishigami was a Japanese astronaut who was residing on the International Space Station when the Petrification on Earth's surface occurred.
150497: Shamil was a Russian Cosmonaut residing on the International Space Station (ISS) when the Petrification on Earth's surface occurred. He returned to Earth's surface along with the rest of the ISS crew, helping to establish Ishigami Village.
